name: opencode-agentrouter-auth
description: Independent AgentRouter provider for magpie and OpenCode: password sign-in entered by the user, ps.air-outer.com by default with explicit endpoint overrides, configurable headers, balance and daily check-in. Derived from ZhaoJun233/agentrouter-magpie-plugin (MIT).
